insights.one_liner: Inalfa is a Venray-based supplier of car roof systems to major carmakers, with 5,000+ staff worldwide and a recognised visa sponsor entity.

culture.text: Inalfa designs, develops and assembles roof systems for the world's largest car brands.
Staff often studied mechanical, mechatronics or electrical engineering at schools like Poznan University of Technology, HAN and Fontys.
Most people work in operations, engineering and quality, with plants and development centres around the world.
